title: UM Sylvester Cancer Clinic
description:
BDI Construction carried out a clinical and healthcare renovation for the UM Sylvester Cancer Clinic, part of the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine and UHealth system. The work covered interior and clinical buildout supporting cancer treatment delivery, specialized care spaces, and patient treatment infrastructure within the UM Miller School/UHealth medical campus network.

Sylvester organizes its cancer research and treatment into 15 site-disease groups — multidisciplinary teams of specialists each focused on a specific type of cancer.
